verdict.rationale: Brex documents admin-created API tokens where you name the token and choose its data-access scopes (brex-docs-2). Granular OAuth scopes include read-only variants such as `cost_centers.readonly` (brex-docs-45), so a least-privilege token can be issued and handed to an agent or integration (brex-docs-50, brex-docs-66). missing for 10: an agent-specific credential type, documentation of how MCP server access is scoped, token expiry/revocation details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
